무엇: 숏영상에 얹을 «대본». 화면이 말하는 것을 그대로 읽는다.
⛔ 지키는 것: 이 파일에 없는 말을 자가 지어내지 않는다. 화면에 없는 수를 목소리로 말하지 않는다. 화면과 소리가 다른 것을 말하면 그 편은 우리를 못 믿게 만든다.
⚠ 길이: 14초 화면에 들어가는 말은 대략 35낱말이다. 넘치면 화면을 늘이지 말고 «말을 줄인다» — make-kcw-sound.mjs 가 그것을 재고 넘치면 멈춘다.

spike-hearts2hearts.제목: Hearts2Hearts was looked up twice as often yesterday on the Vietnamese Wikipedia
spike-hearts2hearts.내레이션: Hearts2Hearts was opened twice as often on the Vietnamese Wikipedia yesterday. Three hundred forty-nine, against a hundred seventy-four a day the week before.
spike-hearts2hearts.설명: We do not know why. Wikipedia records no reason.

onecountry.제목: Mr. Sunshine: 23 weeks on Netflix top 10 — in one country
onecountry.내레이션: Mr. Sunshine held a Netflix top ten place for twenty-three weeks, and never left one country. The middle Korean title we publish reached seven.
onecountry.설명: Long is not wide. We counted both.

tworulers.제목: Two rulers for the same people, and they point at different names
tworulers.내레이션: We measure people two ways: how often their page is opened, and how many countries their titles charted.
tworulers.설명: Of the forty we can measure both ways, not one is top five on both.

numberone.제목: 304 Korean titles have been number one on Netflix. Only 67 reached fifty countries
numberone.내레이션: Three hundred four Korean titles have been number one on Netflix. Only sixty seven ever reached fifty countries.
numberone.설명: Sixty five were number one in the only country that ever charted them.

btsborn.제목: Which BTS member is from Busan? Jimin and Jungkook — and where the other five were born
btsborn.내레이션: Which BTS member is from Busan? Jimin and Jungkook. Suga and V were born in Daegu.
btsborn.설명: Wikidata records a place of birth, which is not the same thing as a hometown.

samename.제목: Is it actually Korean? For 423 of 974 Netflix titles, the name alone cannot tell you
samename.내레이션: Is it actually Korean? For four hundred twenty three of our titles, the name alone cannot tell you.
samename.설명: A Netflix chart row has no year and no country of production.

alongside.제목: Squid Game and My Name were on the same Netflix top 10 — 274 times
alongside.내레이션: Squid Game and My Name shared one country top ten in the same week, two hundred seventy four times.

allten.제목: Four times outside Korea, a whole Netflix TV top 10 was Korean
allten.내레이션: Four times outside Korea, all ten of a country top ten were Korean. Vietnam twice, then Indonesia and Malaysia the same week.
allten.설명: In eleven thousand others, exactly one was.

relay.제목: Vietnam number one was Korean for 34 weeks — held by eleven different series
relay.내레이션: Vietnam number one series was Korean for thirty four weeks straight. Not one show. Eleven of them, taking turns.
relay.설명: The place changed hands thirteen times.

actors.제목: Four Southeast Asian Wikipedias, three different Korean actors at the top
actors.내레이션: Four Southeast Asian Wikipedias, three different Korean actors at the top. Go Youn-jung leads Vietnam and Thailand, Lee Chae-min Indonesia, Moon Ga-young Malaysia.

debut.제목: IU started at 15, Ma Dong-seok at 32 — and it is not just career length
debut.내레이션: Stars who debuted before eighteen are read eleven point eight nine per million. Those who started at twenty six or later, two point four three.
debut.설명: Median career length barely differs across the four bands.

first.제목: One Wikipedia writes Korean titles down first, and it is not the biggest one
first.내레이션: Of twenty five Korean titles written up on all four Wikipedias, the Indonesian one wrote first for twenty four. The Vietnamese, the biggest, for eight.
first.설명: Size does not explain the order.

least.제목: BTS peaks in Vietnam, Byeon Woo-seok in Thailand — and all 20 end in the same place
least.내레이션: BTS peaks in Vietnam, Byeon Woo-seok in Thailand. First place moves. Last does not — Malay is last for all twenty of the most-read.
least.설명: A Malaysian reader can open the Indonesian article.

malaysia.제목: Malaysia reads Korean brands nearly three times as readily as Korean people
malaysia.내레이션: Malaysia's share of four country reading is seven point six to eight point six percent for people. For luxury and car brands, twenty three.
malaysia.설명: That row rests on twenty two brands, not thousands.

manager.제목: A Korean player is read across the region. A manager, in the country that hired him
manager.내레이션: Half a Korean player's reading sits in one country — fifty point five five percent. A manager's, eighty one point three five.
manager.설명: Vietnam hired Kim Sang-sik. Indonesia hired Shin Tae-yong.

onlyone.제목: Only one of four Wikipedias has written about Ahn Sung-ki and Choi Jiwoo
onlyone.내레이션: Ahn Sung-ki has over a hundred thirty films. Choi Jiwoo was in Winter Sonata. Only one of four Wikipedias has written about either.
onlyone.설명: The Indonesian edition — which is not the biggest one.

outside.제목: The most-read Korean place in Vietnamese was a battle fought in Vietnam
outside.내레이션: We published the Battle of Khe Sanh as the most-read Korean place in Vietnamese. It was fought in Vietnam.
outside.설명: Nineteen of our two thousand two hundred thirty eight places are not in Korea.

places.제목: One Korean record label is looked up more than Seoul is
places.내레이션: YG Entertainment scores a hundred eleven point four seven. Seoul, the most-read place of any kind, a hundred six point five four.
places.설명: Five hundred eighteen cities and districts sit below it.

school-one-name.제목: One name moves a whole school's figure from 43 countries to 25
school-one-name.내레이션: Daejin University's five people reach a median forty three countries. Take out Lee You-mi, who reached ninety three, and it drops to twenty five.
school-one-name.설명: The school did not travel. A person did.

shelf.제목: Southeast Asia reads less about Korean language and craft — and less about Japan’s too
shelf.내레이션: Reads of Korean language, hangul and taekwondo fell twenty five point five percent. The Japanese articles beside them, twenty eight point two.
shelf.설명: Both fell. Japan is a control, not a competitor.

signs.제목: Which Korean stars share your Chinese zodiac sign?
signs.내레이션: A thousand forty seven Korean stars, sorted into the twelve zodiac signs by birth year.
signs.설명: Indistinguishable from chance: chi-square seven point seven seven against nineteen point six eight.

works.제목: Actors with five charting titles are read seven times as often — and that says little about one of them
works.내레이션: Actors with five or more charting titles are read seven point one times as often as those with one.
works.설명: Pick one from each group; the busier wins eighty two percent of the time.
